title: VOIDREALM ASHFALL
body:
# VOIDREALM: ASHFALL

**VOIDREALM: ASHFALL** is the official modpack for the VOIDREALM: ASHFALL Minecraft server.

This modpack is made to give players the correct Minecraft version, NeoForge version, mods, and settings needed to join the server without manually installing every mod one by one.

## About the Server

VOIDREALM: ASHFALL is a long-term survival server built around community, exploration, building, danger, and Raid Weekends.

The goal is to create a world with real history over time.

**No wipes.**  
**No resets.**  
**Weekdays are for building.**  
**Weekends are for war.**

## Server Concept

During the week, players can build, prepare, explore, trade, form teams, and get ready.

During Raid Weekend, the server becomes much more dangerous. Players can raid, fight, betray, defend, and compete for survival.

The world is meant to grow, change, and become more destroyed and legendary over time.

## What This Modpack Includes

This modpack includes the required client-side mods for the VOIDREALM: ASHFALL server, including quality-of-life features, exploration, survival content, visual improvements, and gameplay additions.

It is designed to make joining the server easier and more reliable for all players.

## How to Join

1. Install the modpack through Modrinth.
2. Launch the modpack.
3. Go to Multiplayer.
4. Join the official VOIDREALM: ASHFALL server.

**Server IP:**  
`vraf.wisemc.eu`

## Important

Only use the official modpack links posted by staff.

Do not download random mod files from other players.

If you have problems joining, ask for help in the official Discord support channel and include a screenshot of the error message.

## Disclaimer

This is not an official Minecraft product.  
This project is not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.

The Void opens only for the prepared.
